reason: A fixed16MiB execFileSync maxBuffer raises only an observed finite transport limit. Existing child failure propagation, signed candidate authority, direct-parent relation, path/mode allowlist, complete late-marker scan and readText fail-closed semantics remain unchanged. No truncation or new configuration authority is introduced.
exact_test_review_requirements: Large positive must compare complete expected candidate bytes or length+cryptographic digest, not only a successful prefix.
Late marker must be a recognized marker at line start after1MiB and fail specifically for unresolved merge marker, not unrelated signature/path/ENOBUFS.

Overflow fixture must exercise the actual signed resolver against a real blob beyond16MiB and assert the known capacity rejection boundary; positive signed controls establish functioning prerequisites.
All existing tests and checks stay unchanged; semantic test candidates require separate exact-byte independent review.
risks: Each synchronous Git read may now allocate up to16MiB raw output plus decoded/split representations; this is a finite per-read allowance, not a process-memory guarantee.
Above16MiB must remain a failure and trigger separately reviewed streaming/blob-reader design rather than increasing to unbounded memory.
approval_scope: One existing helper option only; no runtime, test-implementation or release approval.
